text: What if Earth got one percent bigger every day? Day seven. Gravity is seven percent stronger. For once, it really isn't you. It's the planet. Day thirty. Earth is a third bigger. Your stairs feel like a mountain. Day seventy. Earth has doubled. You weigh twice as much. Jumping is cancelled. Day one sixty. Five times bigger. Birds walk now. Planes stay on the ground. Day three sixty five. Thirty eight times bigger. You weigh as much as a pickup truck. The good news? There's fourteen hundred times more land. The bad news? Rent still went up. Which day would you leave Earth? Comment below.
